## Text
The enterprise-level co-location model is undergoing profound changes at a time when large models and intelligent bodies are evolving at a high rate. A more flexible, liquid collaborative approach and efficiency revolution led by AI intelligents is opening. According to a recent study by Couchbase, 70 per cent of businesses understand the data required to drive AI as “incomplete”, while still in the long cycle of traditional IT construction, the “turning of elephants” would directly miss the golden window period brought about by this round of AI technology.

Kuailu's Smart Office, as a track pioneer, is based on the AAI raw properties, is fully covered by the AAI Smart Body+ Office scene, with the unique advantages of flow-through data, deep embedded smart technology and full-scale coverage, innovations in enterprise-intelligence synergetic paradigms, and leads client-owned enterprises into the AI Smart Office era!

Drop the heavy load, a digital bottom link to the whole scene.

The wave of digital transformation of enterprises has been in place for more than two decades, from Internet+ to intelligent transformation, mapping the production and management of the physical world between mobile data. However, in the actual transformation of an enterprise, it is often confronted with a system that lacks data. People, goods and services involved in production must be stored and sold, and the day-to-day management must be handled by OA, while the information required for the enterprise to sell will be CRM. A network of interlocking systems leads to severe data faults when enterprises are synergetic, but the real development benefits of enterprises are not visible. Valuable data assets simply sleep in different systems and do not really flow to maximize their value.

Systemic isolation creates data barriers and transforms systems into chains rather than forces. As far back as 2020, Kuailu ' s smart office, the hard work of data on enterprise transformation, was designed to stabilize the technological base and create a coherent data centre for the enterprise. It now covers more than 10 business scenarios, including personnel, finance, procurement, administration and CRM, and is an entry point and a system to meet the requirements of the enterprise ' s development at all stages, as a whole warehouse factory for enterprise transformation!

More than that, Kuailu ' s smart office has a strong isomer integration capability, which allows it to connect seamlessly to the many existing systems of the enterprise, effectively completing the existing digital base, so that the enterprise can have a unified, synergetic, intelligent office data base without pushing back. The Kuailu Smart Office is now widely used in advanced enterprises in manufacturing, commerce, law, etc., in order to provide a system to meet diversified business needs and become a common option for enterprise intellectual upgrading.

AI Native, awakening data assets with intelligence

Gartner predicts that in 2026, 40% of enterprises will apply a mission-based AI smart body. As AI intelligents move towards the realization of the value of scale, there is an urgent need for a Chinese model on how firms can access AI in depth and build AI-based organizations to manage together.

In response, the Kuailu Smart Office was created with the AI Gene. A data base that runs across the entire office landscape is also an adequate flow, flow and activation of all data that not only allows for internal synergy and efficiency, but also transforms enterprise data into data assets that fundamentally accumulates the blood sources needed for AI development.

On the unified data base, the AI intelligent body is the engine that integrates AI office, AI collaboration, AI conference-wide office ecology. At present, AI has infiltrated 30+ business scenes, 21 large application layers of capability, access to six-level AI search questions, office support for specialist intelligence, data analyst intelligence, document analyst intelligence, IT support for specialist intelligence, and so on. Based on large models and data advantages, Kuailu's smart office has summed up the idea of intelligent landings so that data flows really work in managing operations, shifting to business values and unleashing unlimited potential!

(a) Business-knowing assistants: no heavy clicks, manual input, only voice-to-system dialogue to accomplish tasks ranging from document creation, data queries to task management;

Profitable sales helpers: automatically trigger the procurement readiness after a sales signature, automatically update the project budget after a financial payment, and seamlessly interface the entire process. Automation of business searches and the dynamic management of the elderly, with a better ability to produce sales words...

Together, Kuailu works smartly, running the AI era!

It can be asserted that AI intelligence will create a division of individual capabilities, and that the poor ability of enterprises to access data, or to infiltrate AI, will also affect business competitiveness in depth. As an AI smart office pioneer, Kuailu smart office will integrate corporate business landscapes of people, money, goods, etc., with a unified data base, driven by AI smart, allowing enterprise intelligence perceptions, intelligence aids, and smart decision-making!
